title: Dead center
instructions: The room and the rover's starting spot change every time you press Run. Stop on the X in the exact center of the room.
note: The sensor only looks straight ahead, so turn to measure the other ways.
hint: Measure both ways along one line first. If there's 1 empty cell above and 5 below, the middle is (5 - 1) / 2 = 2 cells down. A negative answer means go the other way, and forward(0) is an error, so check with an if before you drive.
